title: The Wilshire | New Lux Villa Mins to Old Town
description:
Airlume Stays presents: The Wilshire - a refined villa curated for the ultimate luxury experience. Host all of your favorite people: True 7 bedrooms/5 bathrooms with a total of 11 pillow-top Beautyrest beds, just minutes away from Old Town Scottsdale, Chase Field, Spring Training and PHX. 

A bespoke wellbeing journey awaits: late mornings nestled up in luxury linens, sunsets in our heated pool and cool nights relaxing in the hot tub. Come relax and reconnect in this Sonoran-inspired manor.

 The space 
Bedroom 1: King Bed with En-Suite Bath | Bedroom 2: King Bed with En-Suite Bath | Bedroom 3: King Bed | Bedroom 4: Queen Bed | Bedroom 5: Queen Bed | Bedroom 6: 2 Twin Beds | Bedroom 7: 4 Full Beds 

We welcome you to enjoy endless amenities at The Wilshire, not limited to: 
- outdoor covered patio to host the ultimate backyard barbecue, complete with propane grill, beverage center, and fire pit
- heated pool and hot tub with poolside lounge beds and chairs 
- ultra-plush Beautyrest mattresses, two types of pillows and fine hotel linens in every bedroom
- fully equipped chef’s kitchen with coffee station area
- Nespresso Machine
- televisions in every bedroom
- spa lotions and shampoos in every bathroom
- outdoor and indoor games

*pool heating/jacuzzi fees may apply to weekday bookings. Heated pool will be only 82-84 degrees from October to March. Heated pool is on scheduled timer. Any alternative arrangement may result in additional fees.

All Airlume properties have a NO CHORES guarantee: we only expect you to put full garbage bags in our dumpster (assuming you don't want bags of trash lying around your living space). However we will assess additional cleaning charges should there be excessive damage/repair/clean up.

Additional services available for a fee (48-hour advance notice required):

- late check-out (price pending availability)
- early check-in, if available (price pending availability)
- fully-stocked refrigerator

License#2038652

 Guest access 
The entire property is yours to explore and use during your stay. We ask that guests do not touch the pool equipment or the vacuum which is very sensitive and is therefore monitored. Also no moving of any furniture is permitted.

 Other things to note 
- Entry : Unique Smartlock Code given to enter premises
- - each guest over 16 guests will be charged an additional fee of 100.00 per day, prior approval must had with management for any guests over 16
- Checkout Time: Before 10am. Prior arrangements must be made in advance for late checkout, if available an additional fee will be assessed. If parties are not checked out by 12:00pm, an additional night stay will be charged.
- House Restrictions: No house parties, No loud music, No events (only occupants of home are allowed in home, no hosting events) --- NoiseAware sensors are set up at the house and any complaints from neighbors and/or authorities will result in automatic checkout and forfeiture of security deposit. NoiseAware is a decibel monitoring system that we use to keep in accordance with local noise regulations. Disclaimer: Nest video system has been installed at the front door and driveway of the house for EXTERIOR ONLY, for your safety. 1000.00 fine for any code violation and/or visitation 
- Equipment: Please do not remove pool vacuum, or fee will be assessed. If there are any issues, please feel free to call us.
- Smoking/Drugs: The house has a strict no smoking or vaping inside the home , smoking is allowed backyard area, please ensure all windows and doors are closed to the inside. If any evidence of smoking, vaping or use of illegal substances is detected on the premises, guests will be automatically checked out, face forfeiture of the stay and an automatic penalty of $2500.00 will apply along with any additional damages and cleaning fees 
- Pet Policy: Due to our owners having severe pet allergies and any pet allergies of future guests and the liability posed, we have a strict NO pets policy which unfortunately also extends to NO service animals, there will be an automatic fine of $2500.00 plus any damages and/our cleaning is additional,outside cameras monitor all occupants entering into home 
- Children/Minors: Must be accompanied at all times when outside due to the risks posed by the pool. Life jackets and flotation devices are available. Any guests under the age of 18 must be disclosed; pool alarms are required to be activated on all entry and exit points leading to the pool for any reservations for children under the age of 18, any tampering or disabling of these pool alarms is an offense and absolves the host of any liability, guest is to ensure these pool alarms are working by testing them and report any issues immediately to host 
-No GLITTER OR CONFETTI, NO DECOR can be affixed to walls or furniture, 1000.00 penalty along with any additional damages and/ or cleaning fees 
- No outside vendors without prior approval and insurance on file, absolutely NO HIBACHI services are allowed at the home, a fine of $2500.00 will be charged along with any damage and additional cleaning this is a severe health and safety risk 
- No glass bottles allowed near pool
- No moving of any furniture 
- under no circumstances are guests allows to ship any items to the home, we are not responsible for any theft or damage to these items, and cannot manage shipments of any kind 
-garage is owners space only and no access is provided for guests 
-coffee: each house has a coffee machine (please ask type) few pods are provided as a starter and guests will order more for their stay
- Number of Guests: May not exceed 16 guests. If there are more than 16 guests sensed by Nest systems, it will result in automatic checkout and forfeiture of security deposit. The correct number of guests must be reported prior to the time of check in as we will not have the correct number of supplies should that number of guests exceed the registered number.
- Garage is unavailable and not included during the stay 
- Guests are not to mail any personal items to the property address, Host is NOT responsible for any lost items and items may arrive early interfering with other guests who may be at the property
-hot tub/ pool heating fee of $150 a night may apply additional charges may occur for any changes, temperature are set to 82 for pool, spa and pool heat is unavailable from June 1st to October 1st, or anytime temperatures average over 85 during stay
- - SUMMER GUESTS: June 1st to October 1st: please note that excessive heat warnings and very high temperatures are the normal and with that AC units are limited to maintain temperature around 72-74 inside, doors to the exterior must not be left opened to avoid extreme heat to come inside, 
Our rates are significantly reduced in the summer and we want to be very transparent on the temperatures/heat warnings and the affects it can have on your stay, during this time the hot tub will be disabled to ensure health and safety along with pool heat, and lastly Arizona summers also bring our seasonal pests, despite monthly pest control, you may unfortunately witness them still, we want you to have an amazing time, however we believe in full transparency always, as this does not just relate to our stays but to the region in general and we always want our guests to be fully informed

Excessive Cleaning charges will apply for instances where makeup or other substances cannot be removed off linens and towels and excessive garbage is found throughout the house along with strong odors, any evidence of vomit and blood will result in a minimum $500.00 fine
amenities: 75 inch HDTV with Apple TV, standard cable, Amazon Prime Video
Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Private hot tub - available seasonally, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, pool toys
